headword: {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}

definitions.explanation: A condition where vehicles on a road are moving very slowly or not at all due to heavy traffic volume, accidents, or road work.

examples.japanese: {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I was late because of a traffic jam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: Traffic congestion is always terrible during long weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}している→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Traffic congestion has occurred on the highway due to an accident.

notes:
{交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい} is composed of ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (traffic) + ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧ (congestion, stagnation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: traffic congestion occurs
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to get caught in a traffic jam
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid traffic congestion
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: traffic congestion information

USAGE: In casual speech, ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧ alone is more common. The full form {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい} is used in news reports, official announcements, and more formal contexts.
